meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: 当你说要执行工作计划时,Claude 会读取 .omo/plans 下的计划,但只负责调度:把写代码、测试、质检等派给并行子代理,自己只做任务拆分、登记状态与证据、勾选完成项。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-execute”或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发;若没有可接续的计划而你又说了 start work,它会先引导生成计划。

say.text: 请用 ulw-execute 继续执行当前计划。
say.note: 会从 Boulder 记录中找到未完成的计划并续跑。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute --make-pr 跑安全加固计划,完成后开 PR。
say.note: 对应 --make-pr,每个阶段的成果会各自开成 PR。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute --ship 跑发布计划,PR 合并后再结束。
say.note: 对应 --ship,合并后清理工作区并同步状态。

howto.what_en: Told to run a plan, Claude only orchestrates: reads a .omo/plans plan, splits work, delegates implementation/test/QA to parallel subagents, never edits product files, and tracks state/evidence/checkboxes until top-level boxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "ulw-execute" or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans. If no plan is selectable and the user said "start work", it bootstraps a plan first.

say_en.text: Please use ulw-execute to continue the current plan.
say_en.note: It resumes the unfinished plan found in Boulder state.

say_en.text: Use ulw-execute --make-pr to run the hardening plan and open a PR when done.
say_en.note: Under --make-pr, each phase is delivered as its own PR.

say_en.text: Use ulw-execute --ship to run the release plan and stop only after the PR merges.
say_en.note: Under --ship, it cleans up the worktree and syncs state.
